title: Dried Fig and Pear Fig Compote
description: The combination of pears and figs in this compote is not only seasonal, but the flavors and textures divine. Pair this fruity, sweet-tart compote with the rich short ribs. It is also great with roast pork and chicken.
ingredients: 4 ounces (about 3/4 cup) dried figs, roughly chopped
4 ounces (about 1 cup) dried pears or mangoes, roughly chopped
directions: Put all ingredients in medium saucepan
Bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 to 1 1/2 hours.
Remove cloves, cinnamon stick, and star anise.
Serve with pork or lamb dishes, or as topping for ice cream. Store in an airtight container with lid in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks.
